envs.summary: Ledgerly: the bills, subscriptions and autopay assistant inside a retail bank app (US / UK / India). Pays card statements, mortgages and utilities; starts, renews, upgrades and cancels subscriptions and free trials; runs standing instructions; reads merchant sign-up, checkout, plan and billing pages and, with Merchant Actions, clicks buttons and emails merchants for the member. Seed pairs S13 S18 S19 S22 S25 S32 S36 S43.
